policyIntro: These rules help families and caregivers agree on safe, respectful childcare arrangements and protect user privacy.
privacyPolicySubtitle: Official Privacy Statement for CareNest Web and Mobile Applications
privacyPolicyIntro: CareNest ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how our web platform and mobile application (package name: com.carenestbooking.app) collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal data, as well as your rights regarding your data under applicable data protection laws and Google Play Store policies.
privacyDataCollectedBody: We collect information you provide directly to us when creating an account, requesting services, or communicating on the platform:
privacyDataAccount: Account Information: Your full name, email address, phone number, encrypted password, and general location (city/neighborhood in Egypt).
privacyDataCaregiver: Caregiver Verification Documents: To ensure trust and child safety, Egyptian caregivers must upload an Egyptian National ID card; caregivers of other nationalities must upload a valid passport and residency visa. These sensitive verification documents are stored securely and reviewed exclusively by platform administrators; they are NEVER made public, displayed to families, or shared with third parties.
privacyDataProfile: Public Profile Data: Profile photo, bio, childcare experience, specialized services (infant care, tutoring, meal prep), language skills, and salary expectations.
privacyDataBooking: Booking Information: Childcare schedules, number and age groups of children, special household instructions, and booking status updates.
privacyDataAuto: Automatically Collected Technical Data: Device model, operating system version, anonymous crash diagnostics, and Google Advertising ID (AD_ID) on Android devices.
privacyPermissionsBody: The CareNest Android application requests the following runtime permissions strictly to support core functionality:
privacyPermissionCamera: Camera (CAMERA): Used exclusively if you choose to take a photo of your national ID, passport, or profile picture directly using the in-app camera.
privacyPermissionStorage: Photo Library & System Picker: Used solely to allow you to select and upload existing photos for your profile or verification documents via the secure Android system photo picker without requiring broad storage access.
privacyPermissionAdId: Advertising ID (AD_ID): Used by the Google Mobile Ads SDK to prevent fraudulent ad activity, cap ad frequency, and deliver relevant advertisements.
privacyDataUseBody: We process personal data only for legitimate platform operations and safety purposes, including:
privacyDataUseItem1: Creating and managing parent, family, and caregiver user accounts.
privacyDataUseItem2: Performing administrative document vetting and identity verification before caregiver profiles can appear in family searches.
privacyDataUseItem3: Enabling families to discover verified caregivers and submit direct childcare requests.
privacyDataUseItem4: Facilitating communication and scheduling between families and caregivers.
privacyDataUseItem5: Delivering advertisements via Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) to support the service.
privacyDataUseItem6: Detecting and preventing fraud, unauthorized account access, and community safety violations.
privacyThirdPartiesBody: We do not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information to third parties. We share data only with the following service providers in accordance with their privacy policies:
privacyThirdPartyAdMob: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob): We display in-app and web advertisements through Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers, cookies, and app usage data to serve and measure advertisements in compliance with Google's Advertising Policies. You can opt out of personalized ads at any time in your Android device settings (Settings > Google > Ads).
privacyThirdPartyAuth: Google Sign-In: If you choose to authenticate using Google OAuth, we access your name and email address as authorized by your Google account profile.
privacyDataRetentionBody: We implement robust administrative, technical, and physical security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, destruction, or disclosure. Caregiver identification documents are encrypted and retained only for the duration of the caregiver's active account to maintain verified status. When an account is terminated, associated verification documents are permanently deleted.
privacyDataDeletionHeading: 6. Your Rights & Account / Data Deletion (Google Play Compliance)
privacyDataDeletionBody: You retain full control over your personal data. You have the right to access, correct, export, or request the complete deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time.
privacyDataDeletionHow: How to Request Deletion: You can delete your profile directly from your profile settings, or by emailing our data protection team at dinamansour2000@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request". Upon receiving your request, your account, personal details, booking records, and all uploaded identity documents will be permanently erased from our active databases within 30 days.
privacyChildrenBody: CareNest is a service directed strictly to adult parents, legal guardians, and professional caregivers aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal information directly from children under the age of 13 (or under 18). Any information related to children (such as age range or care routines) is provided solely by the child's parent or legal guardian for the purpose of booking childcare.
privacyContactBody: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us at: dinamansour2000@gmail.com.
sitterPolicyIntro: By creating a caregiver profile or responding to a request, you agree to follow these standards.
sitterPolicyVerification: Provide truthful identity, experience, contact, availability, and salary details. Egyptian caregivers must submit a national ID; caregivers of other nationalities must submit a passport and valid residency permit or visa. Documents are reviewed by platform admins and are not shown to families. Keep documents current and never upload another person’s identity papers.
sitterPolicySafety: Treat every child with patience and respect. Follow the family’s agreed care instructions, protect children from harm, and contact the parent and emergency services when a child may be in immediate danger. Never use physical punishment, discrimination, harassment, or disclose a child’s private information or images without permission.
sitterPolicyBookings: Accept only work you can safely and reliably provide. Confirm schedule, duties, location, and monthly salary with the family before care begins. Give prompt notice if plans change, and do not share account access or misrepresent another caregiver as yourself.
sitterPolicyEnforcement: Profiles remain hidden until an admin approves the required documents. Admins may request clarification, reject or unapprove a profile, suspend it for a policy breach, or remove it. Once a caregiver accepts a booking, the profile is removed from new family search results. Suspected fraud or unsafe conduct may be referred to relevant authorities.
familyPolicyIntro: Use CareNest respectfully and make childcare arrangements directly and clearly with the caregiver.
familyPolicySafety: Share accurate information about children, routines, health needs, household rules, and emergency contacts. Treat caregivers fairly and respectfully. Agree in advance who may collect a child and how urgent situations should be handled.
familyPolicyBookings: Send genuine requests with correct dates, times, location, and child count. A request is not confirmed until the caregiver accepts it. Discuss duties and payment directly before care starts; CareNest currently lists salary expectations and booking requests but does not collect or process payments. Cancel promptly when plans change.
familyPolicyPrivacy: Use contact details only to arrange or manage care. Do not publish a caregiver’s personal information, copy identity documents, or share a child’s photos or details without appropriate permission. Keep communication on-topic and never threaten, harass, or discriminate.
familyPolicyEnforcement: Report suspected fraud, unsafe conduct, or policy violations to the platform. Admins may investigate, restrict, or remove accounts. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services first.

aboutMissionBody: CareNest was founded with a singular purpose: to bring peace of mind to busy families by making safe, reliable in-home childcare and elderly assistance accessible, transparent, and respectful. We understand that inviting a caregiver into your home is an act of deep trust, which is why we build safety, dignity, and clarity into every stage of the booking process.
aboutStandardsBody: Every caregiver profile on CareNest includes detailed qualifications, verified identity credentials, language fluencies, and transparent hourly rates. Families have full visibility into past client ratings, personal bios, and experience levels, empowering parents to choose the right match for their unique household needs.
aboutValue1Desc: Clear community guidelines, identity verification, and an active safety oversight directory ensure that user wellbeing is always prioritized.
aboutValue2Desc: No hidden booking fees, confusing hourly contracts, or surprise charges. What you see on a caregiver's profile is what you agree upon.
aboutValue3Desc: Designed natively for Egypt and the wider Arab world with complete bilingual Arabic and English support across all devices.
homeHowItWorksTitle: How CareNest Works for Your Family
homeStep1Desc: Explore approved caregiver profiles by city, services, experience, and hourly rates to find the perfect fit for your home.
homeStep2Desc: Select your required dates, specify start and end times, and provide care notes directly to your chosen caregiver.
homeStep3Desc: Track booking confirmations in real-time, communicate seamlessly, and leave verified ratings after care is complete.
